claim: One bounded task in each signed-in native client successfully read a project document through Context Mode and retrieved the exact selected implementation through jCodeMunch; all six selected MCP calls completed.
limitations: Existing Desktop process retains its original loaded MCP connection; fresh native Codex verifies corrected project scope.
Only selected MCP actions exercised; lifecycle compaction and interactive HUD are separate.
Native usage includes prompts, tool schemas, cache reads and reasoning; it is consumed usage, not avoided lifetime tokens.
This is functional integration acceptance with normal configured clients, not a randomized or matched token-savings A/B comparison.
Raw private prompts, client streams, account identifiers and host paths are not published.

usage.subset_rule: Cached input is part of input; reasoning is part of output.
Cache categories are separate input categories; thinking is a subset of output. Do not add per-iteration detail again.

registration.codex: Project-scoped upstream stdio server entry; default index root and sharing disabled.
registration.claude: Upstream local-scope stdio registration; default index root and sharing disabled.
